title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud dev environment setup
body:
## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud specific instructions for developing on this static HTML/CSS/JS web resume. ### What's included - Instructions for serving the site locally (`python3 -m http.server 8080`) - Key notes about the project structure (entry point is `home.html`, jQuery from CDN, no build step) ### Verification The site was served locally and verified in Chrome — all sections render correctly: [demo_web_resume_browsing.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-66208eb9-294a-49cb-acb7-ce43cc9ef2e8/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fdemo_web_resume_browsing.mp4) [Homepage header showing Joshua Harper](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-66208eb9-294a-49cb-acb7-ce43cc9ef2e8/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fhomepage_header.webp) [Projects and footer sections](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-66208eb9-294a-49cb-acb7-ce43cc9ef2e8/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fprojects_footer.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
  
## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Documentation** * Added project documentation with local serving instructions, site access details, build and test guidance, CDN usage, and the primary entry point.
